title: Bot trading with AI
author: kishorekkota
selftext: I am working on building a bot leveraging alpaca market data and IB Pro api. Still building strategy that works based on last 3 months historical data using Claude and Codex. Wanted to check if anyone tried and any tips.

comments.author: Remarkable-Duty8067
comments.body: Expand Datapool, 2015 - today should do it. Kill survivorship biased ticker, find a method to take look ahead bias into account, markout a holdout zone (1-2 last years), dont forget commissions, fees, slippage. Harden your fixed parameters by multiple testruns.

comments.author: Routine_Bat6675
comments.body: I personally have a sentiment based bot for swing trades. i use Sentimentick API and also IBKR Gateway for the execution. works really good for me.

replies.author: kishorekkota
replies.body: Glanced over Sentimentick - 1 REQ/sec limit is restrictive and does not work for BOT trading - IMO

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body: Why not let Codex trade for you?

replies.author: mojovski
replies.body:
My cat would do better performance. AI has no idea about trading. it can code, but it doesnt really understand what's going on.  


I spent quite soe time using AI for trading and my current idea is to use it for coding in soe kind of "Harness".

replies.author: kishorekkota
replies.body: I am not using ai to trade ..I am ai to build comprehensive trade strategy as CODE and a bot that works off live market data for trading

replies.author: kishorekkota
replies.body: Want deterministic - so better build a bot using study vs doing it by Codex or Claude.

replies.author: kishorekkota
replies.body: You want trade based on charting and signal, I am using LLM to build comprehensive strategy, if you need general portfolio recommendation, yes may be. But day trading with LLM is significant amount of token usage and non determisnistic. Instead - me glarring at charting , BOt is doing it and acting on signal.

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body:
And Codex can do exactly that for you. And run from your $200 sub. In fact, you can run multiple bots from one sub.

That still doesn't answer why you think that your algo will do better than Codex trading for you.
